name: lumber-camp
summary: I wrote plan.md for a logging camp on a 40 × 34 block clearing beside a rutted road. It has a dark spruce-log bunkhouse with notched corners, a front porch and a stone cook chimney, plus a tall open sawmill (end facing the road, vent on the ridge, brick boiler stack). Both roof specs passed a dry run with no warnings. It reads as a lumber camp because the logs go in from a log pile at the front, pale sawn boards come out to a yard at the back, and the clearing is full of stumps. A dark spruce-log bunkhouse (cobble plinth, notched corners, porch, fieldstone chimney) beside an open pole-frame sawmill with a brick boiler stack, a log deck, lumber stacks and stumps. I appended elements.md (26 items) and the PALETTE, VOCABULARY (33 helpers), ROOMS and PARTS sections to plan.md, leaving the architect's sections and coordinates unchanged. The six parts split along trades: log shell, sawmill frame, roofs, fittings, chimneys and fires, grounds. I did not run any builds, so none of this has been rendered or walk-checked. (13 of 13 parts finished)
